problem: Two recurring structural surfaces resolve UNDEFINED although the decisions record defines them exactly: the dialog vessel (a modal with ritual details) and the empty state (when no rituals exist). In cadence-dominion both were built only because the builder read docs/synthesis/dominion/decisions.json directly; a consumer working from the pack alone cannot reach either (gap G12).
insufficiency: resolve('a modal with ritual details') -> UNDEFINED; resolve('an empty state when no rituals exist') -> UNDEFINED (closest: guideline/interaction-states 4.0). search('modal') -> no hits; search('dialog') -> only recipe/retire-confirm 1.5; search('empty state') -> only guideline/interaction-states 4.0. The catalogue (packs/dominion/artifacts.json) has no entry for either surface; decisions D-18 and D-16 exist in docs/synthesis/dominion/decisions.json but decisions are not part of the resolvable pack, so no candidate exists at the direct-match threshold.
reuse_case: Dialogs and empty states are the two most frequent structural surfaces in any consumer app: detail overlays, confirmations, first-run and no-results states. cadence-dominion used the dialog for ritual details and for destructive confirms, and the empty state three times (no rituals, filter no-match, achievements demo toggle). The sanctioned destructive recipe (recipe/retire-confirm, D-14) already assumes a dialog vessel it cannot cite.
composition_check: component/action (buttons) and component/field (inputs) supply the ingredients D-14 composes, but neither declares a vessel (frame, scrim, instant behaviour, focus handling) and nothing declares the ruled empty statement. No recipe composes either surface, and a full-kind search finds no candidate. Existing elements therefore cannot compose to a citable answer.
